title: leucanthemum sylvaticum subsp. merinoi
intro: Leucanthemum sylvaticum subsp. merinoi, commonly known as the mountain daisy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Leucanthemum sylvaticum subsp. merinoi include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antispasmodic effects.
